title: Private Deployment Request Eligibility Gate and Network/Upgrade Compatibility Scoring Rubric
creator: Olivia Chen
description:
Problem: We receive frequent private/VPC/on-prem requests that vary widely in networking complexity (air-gapped vs restricted egress vs full VPC peering) and upgrade constraints. Current intake is ad-hoc: high engineering triage time, missed expectations, and long sales cycles.

Goal: Define a lightweight, reproducible eligibility gate and numeric compatibility score to triage customer private deployment requests. The score will determine the next path: self-serve guidance, solutions-eng assisted, or enterprise delivery (on-prem + bespoke engineering).

Scope: Networking constraints, OS/host requirements, allowed egress, KMS/HSM requirements, upgrade cadence constraints, maintenance window tolerance, corporate compliance needs. This ticket is product/PM-owned; includes intake form changes, documentation, and routing rules. Engineering will implement automation hooks in the intake service (routing webhooks), Security will review the gating rules for compliance.

Acceptance criteria:
- A documented scoring rubric with explicit point values for common constraints (air-gapped = +40, Windows-only = +10, strict monthly update ban = +25, external PKI/KMS = +20, minimum network connections allowed = -10 for simple cases).
- Updated intake form with questions that map to rubric fields.
- Routing rules: score <= 15 => self-serve guidance + docs; 16-49 => Solutions Eng review; 50+ => Enterprise delivery discovery call + prioritized queue.
- Automation spec for intake service to compute the score and attach recommended route and one-sentence justification.
- Example customer cases (3) processed through rubric showing expected routing.

Trade-offs and constraints: We must balance speed (fewer false positives to enterprise delivery) vs. revenue risk (missing a true enterprise lead). Initial thresholds are conservative to avoid overcommitting engineering time. We will iterate thresholds after 6 weeks of telemetry.

Open questions for design review:
- Should air-gapped requests always require manual sign-off regardless of score? (security prefers yes)
- How to incorporate customer ARR / strategic value into routing without exposing revenue data in intake? Proposed: add a single-select field for 'customer tier' that maps to a weight applied post-score in the routing logic.
- Where should routing decisions be surfaced? (Console ticketing -> Solutions Eng Slack channel -> Sales CRM webhook)

Implementation notes for Eng:
- Intake service to return JSON with fields: score (integer), route (string), justification (string). PM will provide mapping table.
- Provide an optional 'fast-track' flag that Solutions Eng can toggle for high-strategic customers.

Documentation deliverables:
- Confluence: "Private Deployment Compatibility Matrix v1" with rubric and examples.
- Updated public KB article for customers: "How to request a Private Deployment" with expectations and timeline estimates.
